claims.citation: New York Herald, 28 September 1866, p. 8, col. 2
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Vera Cruz (Fr), Helisrd[?], Havre Sept 8, with
mdse and passengers, to George Mackenzie. From the 9th
to the 15th had very strong, contrary winds, verying from
WNW and WSW, and very heavy seas; from the 15th to the
26th irregular winds from NE to SE; 26th, at 1 PM, took pi-
lot and arrived AM of 27th.
